genuine-table.purpose: Positive control: preserve a real table; unrelated adjacent note is excluded.

regions.text:
SEPARATE NOTICE
The side note is unrelated.
Do not insert it into any
table row or price quotation.

legitimate-column-continuation.purpose: Positive control: a selected quotation genuinely continues from left to right column.

regions.text:
The parties agree that the
document uses a normal reading
order from the first column to
the second column. Every word
belongs to the same paragraph.
The owner records the duty to
retain accurate source evidence.
The agreement continues with

the remaining obligations in
the next column, including the
duty to preserve every selected
word without unrelated text.
A legitimate column transition
must remain possible to locate.
It must not be rejected merely
because it crosses the gutter.

INDEPENDENT FOOTNOTE
This footnote is not part of the continuing paragraph.
